note: M-5 R27 封面 prompt 全文（每張最多 1 次請求）。身分參考依 Image 1–12 順序送入；不含平台 ID。

H-A.prompt:
One single photograph: a premium magazine-cover group portrait of exactly twelve young women together in one room, taken in one moment by one camera. It is not a collage, not a grid and not separate photos combined.

Identity references: the twelve attached images are, in order, Image 1 = Yuna; Image 2 = Rin; Image 3 = Miu; Image 4 = Tammy; Image 5 = Yerin; Image 6 = Coco; Image 7 = Mia; Image 8 = Iris; Image 9 = Jia; Image 10 = Luna; Image 11 = Somi; Image 12 = Rainie. Use each image only for that one woman's face, facial features, skin tone, hair color and hairstyle. Do not copy clothing, background, pose, props, lighting or camera angle from any reference image. Every woman appears exactly once. Exactly twelve people in the photograph: no extra people, no duplicates, no missing person, no reflections, posters or photos of people. Each face stays distinct and matches only its own reference; do not blend faces and do not give two women the same face.

The women (hair and personality):
- Yuna (Image 1): collarbone-length dark brown-black hair with soft airy waves; calm, cool, elegant expression; tall and slender.
- Rin (Image 2): long deep wine-red hair in soft waves; mature, poised, gentle smile.
- Miu (Image 3): platinum ash-blonde shoulder-length bob with airy see-through bangs; sweet, small and petite.
- Tammy (Image 4): long honey-caramel blonde hair in big airy waves with lighter face-framing pieces; chic and confident.
- Yerin (Image 5): long straight flaxen-brown hair with blonde face-framing streaks; sporty, bright smile; the tallest of the group.
- Coco (Image 6): long dark brown curly waves with wispy bangs; bubbly, the widest smile; petite.
- Mia (Image 7): shoulder-length ash-brown loose waves with one pastel-pink face-framing streak; playful; petite.
- Iris (Image 8): long silky straight black hair worn down; round sweet face with a bright girl-next-door smile.
- Jia (Image 9): shoulder-length straight blue-black hair with a mint-green inner layer showing at the ends; cool and composed.
- Luna (Image 10): chin-length straight black bob with blunt bangs; gentle and quiet; the smallest of the group.
- Somi (Image 11): bright copper-orange layered wolf-cut hair; cheerful, open laugh.
- Rainie (Image 12): very long glossy jet-black straight hair with a deep side part; glamorous, defined makeup; hourglass figure.

Wardrobe: one coordinated collection in ivory, cream, champagne and oat tones, same series with different cuts; nude or cream shoes; minimal fine gold jewelry. Yuna wears an ivory tailored blazer and matching wide-leg trousers over a cream silk camisole. Rin wears a champagne satin bias-cut slip midi dress with a soft cowl neckline. Miu wears a cream puff-sleeve mini dress with a square neckline. Tammy wears an oat-beige one-shoulder satin midi dress. Yerin wears an ivory sleeveless fine-knit top tucked into cream high-waisted wide trousers. Coco wears a champagne satin slip mini dress with a cropped cream cardigan. Mia wears an ivory fitted knit top with an oat pleated mini skirt. Iris wears a cream off-shoulder fine-knit top with a champagne satin midi skirt. Jia wears an oat cropped blazer with matching straight trousers over an ivory bandeau top. Luna wears an ivory lace short-sleeve blouse with a cream pleated midi skirt. Somi wears an oat cropped jacket with a matching mini skirt over a cream top. Rainie wears a champagne satin strapless fitted maxi dress with a side slit.

Setting: A bright ivory photo studio: a seamless warm-white backdrop curving into the floor, one long low cream plinth platform about 40 cm high, one low cream ottoman and one rounded cream lounge chair, all in one continuous space. Soft diffused daylight from a large window-like source on the left, gentle fill, soft natural shadows on the floor. Clean and airy; no props other than this furniture.

Arrangement (left to right):
- Yerin (Image 5): far left, standing, one hand loosely in her trouser pocket.
- Tammy (Image 4): seated sideways on the left end of the low plinth, legs crossed.
- Rin (Image 2): standing just behind Tammy, one hand resting lightly on Tammy's shoulder.
- Miu (Image 3): sitting on the floor in front of the plinth, legs folded to one side, leaning toward Tammy.
- Yuna (Image 1): standing left of center, slightly behind the plinth.
- Iris (Image 8): seated in the middle of the plinth, hands on her knees, smiling.
- Luna (Image 10): sitting on a low cream ottoman in front, just right of center.
- Jia (Image 9): standing right of center behind the plinth, one hand on her hip.
- Somi (Image 11): perched on the right end of the plinth, laughing toward Coco.
- Coco (Image 6): sitting in a rounded cream lounge chair on the right.
- Mia (Image 7): sitting on the floor in front of Coco's chair, legs to the side.
- Rainie (Image 12): far right, standing and leaning one hand on the arm of Coco's chair.

Horizontal 4:3 frame. The group spreads from left to right across the whole width in a relaxed, staggered arrangement at different heights (standing, perched, seated, on the floor), not in rigid rows and not a graduation photo. Keep the top 22% of the frame as clean empty background with no heads or hands in it (reserved for a title added later). Keep every person at least 4% away from the left and right edges. Full-length figures on one shared floor.

The feeling is a relaxed annual editorial group portrait: friends at ease, a few soft laughs, most of them looking toward the camera. Every face is clearly visible and in focus; no face hidden, turned away or covered by hands, hair or glasses.

Photography: medium-format camera at chest height from about six meters, 50mm-equivalent lens, f/8 so all twelve faces are sharp, no wide-angle distortion. One shared light and perspective for everyone; consistent shadows on the floor. Natural adult proportions, realistic hands with five fingers, believable overlaps and touch (a hand on a shoulder, leaning together), no merged or extra limbs. Natural skin texture, true-to-life color, refined editorial finish.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or magazine masthead anywhere in the image.
